title: Family band and Sunday jam sessions
summary: Quezergue says he played trumpet, learned reading through the family orchestra and Mr. Kerr, and describes the Sunday family jam sessions; the ASR degenerates into a loop.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: What did you play? I played trumpet. Okay. You know.

And we did a lot of jazz and things of that sort. And I used to play with the, like I said, my family band and things like that. We had an orchestra and used to, that's how I got my reading ability through that, that was it, plus Mr. Kerr. You know.
From your, from, more from the family?
My family, not the reading, but the musical part, yes.
Well, tell me about what the family would do. How would you all get together? Was it?

Well, it was a thing that every Sunday, it was a Sunday affair, that we would have either in the backyard or we would be in the, in the, in the kitchen and things of that sort. And we would just have a jam session every Sunday, you know. How dear
